_notice: FICTITIOUS. Generated visits to an HCP portal (quorvantahcp.example) for a product that does not exist.
usage: One record per session on the HCP portal between 2026-01-01 and the as_of date. hcp_id is set when a registered prescriber is signed in and null for anonymous visitors. source is email (with email_id, starting within 60 seconds of a human click in hcp-emails.json), rep_link, search or direct. region is the state the connection comes from. page_views give each page's id from the pages catalog in this header, its offset from the session start and the seconds spent on it. Gated pages need a signed-in, verified prescriber. quality_flags mark sessions that should not count as engagement or that a portal should have refused.

quality_flags.bot_session: Automated traffic: 15 or more page views, each under 2 seconds.
quality_flags.shared_login: The same prescriber signed in from two regions at overlapping times; 'of' is the other session.
quality_flags.inactive_prescriber_login: Signed in as a prescriber who is retired or whose NPI was deactivated before the session.
quality_flags.gated_page_unverified: A gated page viewed in an anonymous session.
